content:
Daily messages — collected through 2026-09-15T20:25:00-04:00

Conversation: imessage | thread-6956a8ddb6f1be6162de33e9
Participants: Me, Maya

[2026-09-15T18:00:00-04:00] Maya
finally home ugh

[2026-09-15T18:00:50-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
same, took me forever to get out of the parking lot

[2026-09-15T18:01:40-04:00] Maya
did you end up staying late?

[2026-09-15T18:02:30-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
yeah like 20 mins, nothing crazy

[2026-09-15T18:02:55-04:00] Maya
nice, I'm just heating up leftovers

[2026-09-15T18:11:15-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
what'd you have?

[2026-09-15T18:13:46-04:00] Maya
that veggie stir fry from yesterday, still pretty good

[2026-09-15T18:14:11-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
oh nice, I had a sad desk salad lol

[2026-09-15T18:14:36-04:00] Maya
lol classic

[2026-09-15T18:15:01-04:00] Maya
hey we still need to catch up properly soon

[2026-09-15T18:23:22-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
yes! it's been too long

[2026-09-15T18:23:47-04:00] Maya
wanna do something easy like pizza on Friday?

[2026-09-15T18:24:12-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
yes please, I'm craving pizza

[2026-09-15T18:32:32-04:00] Maya
same, how about Rosa's on Oak Street?

[2026-09-15T18:32:57-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
oh I love that place

[2026-09-15T18:35:28-04:00] Maya
right? their garlic knots are dangerous

[2026-09-15T18:35:53-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
seriously, I always eat too many

[2026-09-15T18:38:23-04:00] Maya
okay so Friday at 1 pm?

[2026-09-15T18:46:44-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
yeah that works for me

[2026-09-15T18:47:09-04:00] Maya
perfect

[2026-09-15T18:49:39-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
are you working from home that day?

[2026-09-15T18:50:04-04:00] Maya
yeah, so I can just walk over

[2026-09-15T18:52:34-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
nice, I'm in office but I can slip out for lunch

[2026-09-15T18:55:04-04:00] Maya
how long can you stay?

[2026-09-15T19:03:25-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
probably like an hour, hour and a half?

[2026-09-15T19:04:15-04:00] Maya
that's plenty

[2026-09-15T19:04:40-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
did you see they redid the patio there?

[2026-09-15T19:05:05-04:00] Maya
no! is it nice now?

[2026-09-15T19:05:30-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
yeah way more tables, less wobbly chairs lol

[2026-09-15T19:06:20-04:00] Maya
thank god those chairs were scary

[2026-09-15T19:06:33-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
right?

[2026-09-15T19:14:53-04:00] Maya
btw are you still doing that pottery class?

[2026-09-15T19:15:44-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
yeah tomorrow night is week 3

[2026-09-15T19:24:04-04:00] Maya
how's it going?

[2026-09-15T19:24:54-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
messy but fun, my bowl looks lopsided

[2026-09-15T19:25:19-04:00] Maya
that's the charm tho

[2026-09-15T19:33:40-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
that's what the teacher says too lol

[2026-09-15T19:36:10-04:00] Maya
my sister wants to join one, I'll send her your studio

[2026-09-15T19:38:41-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
yes do it, Tuesday guy is super chill

[2026-09-15T19:47:01-04:00] Maya
oh cool, I'll tell her

[2026-09-15T19:49:31-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
what are you up to tomorrow?

[2026-09-15T19:52:02-04:00] Maya
just work and laundry, thrilling stuff

[2026-09-15T19:54:32-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
lol same, I need to water my plants too they're dying

[2026-09-15T20:02:53-04:00] Maya
oh no, my basil already gave up

[2026-09-15T20:03:18-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
RIP basil

[2026-09-15T20:04:08-04:00] Maya
lol it'll be resurrected from the grocery store

[2026-09-15T20:12:28-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
hahaha fair

[2026-09-15T20:14:59-04:00] Maya
okay so I'm excited for Friday, been craving their pepperoni

[2026-09-15T20:17:29-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
same, I'm getting a side salad to pretend I'm healthy

[2026-09-15T20:19:59-04:00] Maya
lol get the knots too, balance

[2026-09-15T20:22:29-04:00] Me (sent by owner)
exactly, perfect balance

[2026-09-15T20:25:00-04:00] Maya
okay gonna go eat before this gets cold, talk later?
